## Objective
Close the MEM-145 loop on the memento side: after the OLI-17 specimen run, nothing was queued or recallable. Give run evidence a deterministic ingest path with a provable recall guarantee.

## Design summary
Bound decision (made in the envelope session): the v1 mechanism is an EXPLICIT ingest command, not implicit lifecycle magic - Rondo (or an operator) calls it with a payload; automatic emission from Rondo is a separate rondo-side ticket to note in your final report.
- Reuse the existing machinery: memento/automated_run_lessons.py already has capture_automated_run_lesson (L122), queue_lesson_candidate (L160), and lesson_to_note_payload (L247), consumed today by mcp_server.py. Do not fork it.
- Add a `run-lesson` subcommand to the pi_bridge argparse CLI (parser registration near pi_bridge.py L2873, dispatch near L3062) accepting --payload <json-file> with fields: run_id (required), ticket_id (required), title, lesson_text, evidence_paths[], tags[]. It normalizes via the existing functions and captures a note.
- Recall guarantee: the produced note's searchable text MUST embed run_id and ticket_id verbatim (search.py is_literal_like_query L199 routes identifier-shaped queries to literal matching - verified; a run id like RON-160-20260705T031413Z-d846d0b8 trips the digit/hyphen heuristics).
- Integration test (the ticket's 'deterministic integration check'): ingest a sample payload into a tmp vault, then assert search by the run id and by the ticket id each return the note. Use the hermetic test patterns from existing capture-e2e tests.
- Document the payload contract + command in the repo docs so Rondo's future emission has a stable target.

## File scope
Include: memento/automated_run_lessons.py, memento/pi_bridge.py (one subcommand), tests, docs. Exclude: Rondo-side emission, Pi lifecycle capture changes, fixing pi-bridge failure counts (report the current triage-health.jsonl failure count in your final report if you look, but do not fix).

## Constraints
Gates via .venv/bin/python. No remote writes. Do not restructure the pi_bridge CLI (mem-129 just moved its queue internals - build on that state).

## Verification
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_script_harnesses.py tests/test_pi_bridge.py
.venv/bin/python -m ruff check . && .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check .
